segments.src: It did not repeal price risk, illiquidity, or the fact that every parcel is unique.
segments.tr: Teknologi tidak menghapus risiko harga, ketidaklikuidan, atau fakta bahwa setiap bidang tanah itu unik.

segments.src: Expect more of the same: cheaper information, faster transactions, unchanged fundamentals.
segments.tr: Harapkan hal serupa: informasi yang lebih murah, transaksi yang lebih cepat, fundamental yang tidak berubah.

segments.src: **Demographics: households, not people.** Population growth doesn't buy houses — *household formation* does.
segments.tr: **Demografi: rumah tangga, bukan orang.** Pertumbuhan populasi tidak membeli rumah — *pembentukan rumah tangga* yang melakukannya.

segments.src: Two roommates splitting a one-bedroom are one household; when they split up, they're two, and demand just rose without a single birth.
segments.tr: Dua teman sekamar yang membagi unit satu kamar tidur adalah satu rumah tangga; ketika mereka berpisah, mereka menjadi dua, dan permintaan baru saja meningkat tanpa ada satu kelahiran pun.

segments.src: That's why the demographic picture matters in specifics:
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya gambaran demografi penting dalam hal spesifik:

segments.src: - **Boomers (born 1946–1964, so 62 to 80 today) are aging in place.** Historically, older owners downsized and released inventory. Many now stay — the home is paid off or carries a low fixed-rate mortgage they'd lose by moving. Fewer sellers means tighter resale supply, independent of new construction.
segments.tr: - **Generasi Baby Boomer (lahir 1946–1964, sehingga berusia 62 hingga 80 tahun saat ini) menua di tempat.** Secara historis, pemilik yang lebih tua mengecilkan ukuran rumah dan melepas inventaris. Banyak yang sekarang tetap tinggal — rumah tersebut telah lunas atau memiliki hipotek tingkat tetap yang rendah yang akan hilang jika mereka pindah. Lebih sedikit penjual berarti pasokan penjualan kembali yang lebih ketat, terlepas dari konstruksi baru.

segments.src: - **Millennials are in peak buying years, late.** The largest adult generation is now roughly 30 to 45. Recent National Association of Realtors surveys put the median first-time buyer in their late 30s — a large jump from around 30 in the early 1980s. Demand delayed is not demand destroyed, but it changes what people buy and when.
segments.tr: - **Generasi Milenial berada di tahun-tahun puncak pembelian, tetapi terlambat.** Generasi dewasa terbesar kini berusia sekitar 30 hingga 45 tahun. Survei National Association of Realtors baru-baru ini menempatkan pembeli rumah pertama kali rata-rata berusia akhir 30-an — lonjakan besar dari sekitar usia 30 pada awal 1980-an. Permintaan yang ditunda bukanlah permintaan yang dimusnahkan, tetapi itu mengubah apa yang dibeli orang dan kapan.

segments.src: - **Migration is the local story.** Sun Belt metros keep absorbing domestic movers; high-cost coastal metros keep exporting them. Immigration is a swing variable large enough to move national household formation on its own.
segments.tr: - **Migrasi adalah cerita lokal.** Metro Sun Belt terus menyerap pemindahan domestik; metro pesisir dengan biaya tinggi terus mengekspor mereka. Imigrasi adalah variabel penyeimbang yang cukup besar untuk mengubah pembentukan rumah tangga nasional dengan sendirinya.

segments.src: - **Two new underwriting variables.** Insurance cost is now a real line item in Florida, Louisiana, and parts of California — enough to change what a buyer can afford at the same price. And office space is in a structural repricing after remote work, with record-high vacancy in some downtowns and a slow trickle of office-to-residential conversions where the floor plates and plumbing allow.
segments.tr: - **Dua variabel penjaminan baru.** Biaya asuransi sekarang menjadi pos anggaran nyata di Florida, Louisiana, dan sebagian California — cukup untuk mengubah apa yang mampu dibeli pembeli pada harga yang sama. Dan ruang kantor mengalami penyesuaian harga struktural setelah kerja jarak jauh, dengan tingkat kekosongan tertinggi yang pernah tercatat di beberapa pusat kota dan tetesan lambat konversi kantor ke hunian di mana pelat lantai dan sistem plambing mengizinkannya.

segments.src: Honest framing: nobody forecasts a point.
segments.tr: Penyusunan yang jujur: tidak ada yang meramalkan satu titik.

segments.src: You forecast *drivers* — interest rates, construction costs, household formation, and policy (zoning reform like Minneapolis ending single-family-only zoning, or the wave of state ADU laws) — and you carry a range.
segments.tr: Anda meramalkan *faktor pendorong* — suku bunga, biaya konstruksi, pembentukan rumah tangga, dan kebijakan (reformasi zonasi seperti Minneapolis yang mengakhiri zonasi khusus keluarga tunggal, atau gelombang undang-undang ADU negara bagian) — dan Anda membawa sebuah rentang.

segments.src: ### The whole course, in one pass
segments.tr: ### Seluruh kursus, dalam sekali jalan

segments.src: 1. **Property is a bundle of rights** — use, exclude, transfer — not just dirt.
segments.tr: 1. **Properti adalah sekumpulan hak** — penggunaan, pengecualian, transfer — bukan hanya tanah.

segments.src: 2. **The market is local, illiquid, and heterogeneous**, so "the housing market" is a convenient fiction.
segments.tr: 2. **Pasar bersifat lokal, tidak likuid, dan heterogen**, jadi "pasar perumahan" adalah fiksi yang nyaman.

segments.src: 3. **Supply is inelastic short-run**; demand shocks hit price before they hit quantity.
segments.tr: 3. **Pasokan tidak elastis dalam jangka pendek**; guncangan permintaan menghantam harga sebelum menghantam kuantitas.

segments.src: 4. **Value has three lenses**: sales comparison, cost, and income.
segments.tr: 4. **Nilai memiliki tiga lensa**: perbandingan penjualan, biaya, dan pendapatan.

segments.src: 5. **Highest and best use** — legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, maximally productive.
segments.tr: 5. **Penggunaan tertinggi dan terbaik** — diizinkan secara hukum, dimungkinkan secara fisik, layak secara finansial, produktif secara maksimal.

segments.src: 6. **`NOI = Gross Income − Vacancy − Operating Expenses`** (debt service is *not* an operating expense).
segments.tr: 6. **`NOI = Gross Income − Vacancy − Operating Expenses`** (layanan utang *bukan* biaya operasional).

segments.src: 7. **`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`** — a price tag on risk and growth, not a return you'll actually receive.
segments.tr: 7. **`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`** — label harga pada risiko dan pertumbuhan, bukan pengembalian yang sebenarnya akan Anda terima.

segments.src: 8. **Mortgages**: amortization, fixed vs. adjustable, LTV, DTI.
segments.tr: 8. **Hipotek**: amortisasi, tetap vs. dapat disesuaikan, LTV, DTI.

segments.src: 9. **Leverage** amplifies both directions; it's positive only while returns exceed borrowing cost.
segments.tr: 9. **Leverage** memperkuat kedua arah; itu positif hanya ketika pengembalian melebihi biaya pinjaman.

segments.src: 10. **Cash flow analysis** beats appreciation stories, because appreciation is a guess and cash flow is a schedule.
segments.tr: 10. **Analisis arus kas** mengalahkan cerita apresiasi, karena apresiasi adalah tebakan dan arus kas adalah jadwal.

segments.src: 11. **Taxes matter**: depreciation, deductions, 1031 exchanges.
segments.tr: 11. **Pajak penting**: penyusutan, potongan, pertukaran 1031.

segments.src: 12. **Land use and zoning** decide what can exist before economics decides what should.
segments.tr: 12. **Penggunaan lahan dan zonasi** memutuskan apa yang dapat eksis sebelum ekonomi memutuskan apa yang seharusnya.

segments.src: 13. **Brokerage and agency**: fiduciary duty, disclosure, and how the transaction actually closes.
segments.tr: 13. **Pialang dan keagenan**: kewajiban fidusia, pengungkapan, dan bagaimana transaksi benar-benar ditutup.

segments.src: 14. **Development and property management**: entitlement risk up front, operating discipline forever after.
segments.tr: 14. **Pengembangan dan manajemen properti**: risiko hak di depan, disiplin operasional selamanya setelahnya.

segments.src: 15. **Cycles**: recovery, expansion, hypersupply, recession — and the lag that makes overbuilding chronic.
segments.tr: 15. **Siklus**: pemulihan, ekspansi, pasokan berlebih, resesi — dan jeda yang membuat pembangunan berlebih menjadi kronis.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Priya and Marcus are shopping in Charlotte, North Carolina, with about $85,000 down.
segments.tr: Priya dan Marcus sedang berbelanja di Charlotte, Carolina Utara, dengan uang muka sekitar $85.000.

segments.src: They start on a listing app.
segments.tr: Mereka mulai di aplikasi daftar properti.

segments.src: A three-bedroom in NoDa shows an online estimate of $412,000.
segments.tr: Rumah tiga kamar tidur di NoDa menunjukkan perkiraan online sebesar $412.000.

segments.src: They offer $405,000, get it accepted — and the appraisal comes back at $395,000.
segments.tr: Mereka menawar $405.000, diterima — dan penilaian kembali (appraisal) berada di angka $395.000.

segments.src: That $10,000 gap is theirs to cover in cash, because the lender lends against the appraisal, not the algorithm (Lectures 4 and 8).
segments.tr: Selisih $10.000 itu harus mereka tutupi secara tunai, karena pemberi pinjaman memberikan pinjaman berdasarkan penilaian, bukan algoritma (Kuliah 4 dan 8).

segments.src: Proptech got them to the house on a Tuesday night; it didn't get them the value.
segments.tr: Proptech membawa mereka ke rumah itu pada Selasa malam; itu tidak memberi mereka nilai tersebut.

segments.src: The seller is 74 and selling because stairs became a problem — he's moving to a single-level place near his daughter.
segments.tr: Penjualnya berusia 74 tahun dan menjual karena tangga menjadi masalah — ia pindah ke tempat satu lantai dekat putrinya.

segments.src: His neighbors on both sides, same age, aren't moving at all.
segments.tr: Tetangganya di kedua sisi, dengan usia yang sama, sama sekali tidak pindah.

segments.src: That's the aging-in-place story in one cul-de-sac, and it's why only nine homes in the neighborhood have traded in three years.
segments.tr: Itulah kisah penuaan di tempat dalam satu area perumahan, dan itulah sebabnya hanya sembilan rumah di lingkungan tersebut yang telah diperjualbelikan dalam tiga tahun.

segments.src: Priya and Marcus had also looked in Tampa, where the sticker prices were lower.
segments.tr: Priya dan Marcus juga sempat melihat-lihat di Tampa, di mana harga stikernya lebih rendah.

segments.src: The homeowner's insurance quote — several times what Charlotte runs — erased the difference.
segments.tr: Kutipan asuransi pemilik rumah — beberapa kali lipat dari biaya di Charlotte — menghapus perbedaan tersebut.

segments.src: Same salary, same rate, different affordability.
segments.tr: Gaji yang sama, suku bunga yang sama, keterjangkauan yang berbeda.

segments.src: That's the new variable, and it doesn't show up in the list price.
segments.tr: Itulah variabel baru, dan itu tidak muncul di harga daftar.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Rekap Tiga Baris

segments.src: - Proptech has crushed information and transaction friction, but valuation risk and illiquidity are unchanged — the Zillow iBuying shutdown is the case study.
segments.tr: - Proptech telah menghancurkan informasi dan gesekan transaksi, tetapi risiko penilaian dan ketidaklikuidan tidak berubah — penutupan iBuying Zillow adalah studi kasusnya.

segments.src: - Household formation, not population, drives housing demand; boomers aging in place and millennials buying later are reshaping supply and product type simultaneously.
segments.tr: - Pembentukan rumah tangga, bukan populasi, mendorong permintaan perumahan; generasi baby boomer yang menua di tempat dan milenial yang membeli lebih lambat sedang membentuk kembali pasokan dan jenis produk secara bersamaan.

segments.src: - Forecast drivers and ranges — rates, construction costs, household formation, insurance, and zoning policy — never a single number.
segments.tr: - Penggerak dan rentang perkiraan — suku bunga, biaya konstruksi, pembentukan rumah tangga, asuransi, dan kebijakan zonasi — tidak pernah berupa satu angka tunggal.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

segments.src: **Q1.** Which best explains why housing supply responds slowly to a demand shock?
segments.tr: **Q1.** Mana yang paling menjelaskan mengapa pasokan perumahan merespons secara lambat terhadap guncangan permintaan?

segments.src: (a) Buyers need time to get pre-approved
segments.tr: (a) Pembeli membutuhkan waktu untuk mendapatkan pra-persetujuan

segments.src: (b) Entitlement, financing, and construction take years
segments.tr: (b) Hak, pembiayaan, dan konstruksi memakan waktu bertahun-tahun

segments.src: (c) Brokers limit how many listings they take
segments.tr: (c) Pialang membatasi berapa banyak daftar yang mereka ambil

segments.src: (d) Appraisals are backward-looking
segments.tr: (d) Penilaian melihat ke belakang

segments.src: **Q2.** (O/X) An online automated valuation model (AVM) estimate is functionally the same as a lender's appraisal.
segments.tr: **Q2.** (O/X) Perkiraan model penilaian otomatis (AVM) online secara fungsional sama dengan penilaian pemberi pinjaman.

segments.src: **Q3.** Which most directly drives housing demand?
segments.tr: **Q3.** Mana yang paling langsung mendorong permintaan perumahan?

segments.src: (a) Total population
segments.tr: (a) Total populasi

segments.src: (b) Number of licensed agents
segments.tr: (b) Jumlah agen berlisensi

segments.src: (c) Household formation
segments.tr: (c) Pembentukan rumah tangga

segments.src: (d) The national homeownership rate
segments.tr: (d) Tingkat kepemilikan rumah nasional

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — (b).** From entitlement to certificate of occupancy is typically two to five years, so short-run supply is close to fixed and demand shocks land on price first (Lecture 3).*
segments.tr: *Jawaban: **Q1 — (b).** Dari hak hingga sertifikat layak huni biasanya membutuhkan waktu dua hingga lima tahun, sehingga pasokan jangka pendek hampir tetap dan guncangan permintaan mendarat pada harga terlebih dahulu (Kuliah 3).*

segments.src: ***Q2 — X.** An AVM is a statistical estimate from public records and comps; an appraisal is a licensed professional's opinion of value, and the lender sizes the loan off the appraisal.
segments.tr: ***Q2 — X.** AVM adalah perkiraan statistik dari catatan publik dan data pembanding; penilaian adalah pendapat profesional berlisensi tentang nilai, dan pemberi pinjaman menentukan ukuran pinjaman berdasarkan penilaian tersebut.

segments.src: The gap between them is paid in cash by the buyer.*
segments.tr: Selisih di antara keduanya dibayar secara tunai oleh pembeli.*

segments.src: ***Q3 — (c).** Households, not individuals, occupy units.
segments.tr: ***Q3 — (c).** Rumah tangga, bukan individu, yang mendiami unit.

segments.src: Population can be flat while demand rises if people form smaller, more numerous households — through delayed marriage, divorce, or aging alone.*
segments.tr: Populasi bisa tetap datar sementara permintaan meningkat jika orang membentuk rumah tangga yang lebih kecil dan lebih banyak — melalui penundaan pernikahan, perceraian, atau penuaan sendirian.*

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

segments.src: - **Proptech** — technology applied to property information, transactions, and building operations.
segments.tr: - **Proptech** — teknologi yang diterapkan pada informasi properti, transaksi, dan operasi bangunan.

segments.src: - **AVM (Automated Valuation Model)** — a statistical home value estimate built from public records and comparable sales; not an appraisal.
segments.tr: - **AVM (Automated Valuation Model)** — perkiraan nilai rumah statistik yang dibangun dari catatan publik dan penjualan yang sebanding; bukan sebuah penilaian.

segments.src: - **Household formation** — the rate at which new occupied housing units are created; the truest demand driver in housing.
segments.tr: - **Pembentukan rumah tangga** — tingkat di mana unit perumahan baru yang dihuni diciptakan; pendorong permintaan sejati dalam perumahan.

segments.src: - **Aging in place** — older owners staying in their homes rather than downsizing, which reduces resale inventory turnover.
segments.tr: - **Aging in place** — pemilik yang lebih tua tetap tinggal di rumah mereka daripada mengecilkan ukuran, yang mengurangi perputaran inventaris penjualan kembali.

segments.src: - **Adaptive reuse** — converting a building to a new use (most topically, office to residential) when the structure and systems permit it.
segments.tr: - **Adaptive reuse** — mengubah bangunan ke penggunaan baru (paling topikal, kantor ke hunian) ketika struktur dan sistem mengizinkannya.

ja.title: [不動産入門 #15] 次の10年はすでに建設中 — プロプテック、人口動態、そして全講義の総まとめを一挙に

segments.src: > Real estate changes slowly, which is exactly why the two slowest forces — technology and demographics — are the ones worth watching. Here's the outlook, plus a one-pass recap of everything from Lecture 1 to now.
segments.tr: > 不動産の変化は緩慢であり、それゆえに最も遅い2つの力（テクノロジーと人口動態）こそが注視する価値のあるものです。今回は今後の展望に加え、第1講から現在までの総復習をお届けします。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 本日のコンセプト

segments.src: Most forecasts fail because they try to guess next quarter.
segments.tr: ほとんどの予測が外れる理由は、次の四半期を当てようとするからです。

segments.src: Real estate barely moves that fast.
segments.tr: 不動産はそれほど速く動きません。

segments.src: A subdivision takes two to four years from raw land to keys; an apartment tower can take five.
segments.tr: 分譲地造成は未開発地から鍵の引き渡しまで2〜4年かかり、アパートタワーは5年かかることもあります。

segments.src: Zoning changes take longer than that.
segments.tr: 用途地域の変更にはそれ以上の時間がかかります。

segments.src: So the useful question isn't "where are prices going next month" — it's "which slow forces are already locked in?"
segments.tr: したがって、有益な問いは「来月、価格はどこに向かうのか」ではなく、「どの緩慢な力がすでに固定化されているのか」なのです。

segments.src: Two are.
segments.tr: 2つあります。

segments.src: **Proptech: friction is disappearing, risk isn't.** Technology has arrived in property in three layers.
segments.tr: **プロプテック：摩擦は消えても、リスクは消えない。** テクノロジーは3つのレイヤーで不動産業界に到来しました。

segments.src: The *information* layer came first — listing portals and automated valuation models turned a business built on private data into one where a buyer can pull comps at midnight.
segments.tr: まず*情報*レイヤーが訪れました。リスティングポータルや自動評価モデル（AVM）により、非公開データに基づいて構築されていたビジネスが、買い手が真夜中に類似物件のデータを引き出せるものへと変わりました。

segments.src: The *transaction* layer came next: digital closings, remote online notarization, title automation, and "iBuyers" that buy your house with an algorithm and a cash offer.
segments.tr: 次に*取引*レイヤーが訪れました：デジタル決済、リモートオンライン公証、権利証書（タイトル）の自動化、そしてアルゴリズムと現金オファーで家を購入する「iBuyer」です。

segments.src: The *operations* layer is the quietest and probably the largest — building management software, smart meters, energy analytics, and leasing platforms that squeeze cost out of the 30 years *after* the sale.
segments.tr: *運営*レイヤーは最も静かでありながら、おそらく最大のものでしょう。ビル管理ソフトウェア、スマートメーター、エネルギー分析、そして売却後の30年間からコストを削り出すリーシングプラットフォームなどです。

segments.src: The instructive part is where proptech has failed.
segments.tr: 示唆に富むのは、プロプテックが失敗した分野です。

segments.src: Zillow shut down its home-buying arm in 2021 after heavy losses; a model that estimates value well on average can still be wrong expensively on individual houses.
segments.tr: Zillowは多額の損失を出した後の2021年に住宅買取部門を閉鎖しました。平均的な価値をうまく見積もるモデルであっても、個別の住宅においては高額な間違いを犯すことがあるのです。

segments.src: Technology compressed information asymmetry and paperwork.
segments.tr: テクノロジーは情報の非対称性と書類手続きを圧縮しました。

segments.src: It did not repeal price risk, illiquidity, or the fact that every parcel is unique.
segments.tr: しかし、価格リスク、流動性の低さ、そしてすべての物件がユニークであるという事実を消し去ることはできませんでした。

segments.src: Expect more of the same: cheaper information, faster transactions, unchanged fundamentals.
segments.tr: 今後も同様の傾向が続くでしょう：より安価な情報、より迅速な取引、そして変わらないファンダメンタルズです。

segments.src: **Demographics: households, not people.** Population growth doesn't buy houses — *household formation* does.
segments.tr: **人口動態：人間ではなく、世帯。** 人口増加は家を買うわけではなく、*世帯形成*が家を買うのです。

segments.src: Two roommates splitting a one-bedroom are one household; when they split up, they're two, and demand just rose without a single birth.
segments.tr: 1LDKをシェアする2人のルームメイトは1つの世帯ですが、別居すれば2世帯となり、出生数がゼロでも需要が急増します。

segments.src: That's why the demographic picture matters in specifics:
segments.tr: だからこそ、人口動態の状況を具体的に把握することが重要なのです。

segments.src: - **Boomers (born 1946–1964, so 62 to 80 today) are aging in place.** Historically, older owners downsized and released inventory. Many now stay — the home is paid off or carries a low fixed-rate mortgage they'd lose by moving. Fewer sellers means tighter resale supply, independent of new construction.
segments.tr: - **ベビーブーマー（1946〜1964年生まれ、現在62〜80歳）は住み慣れた家に住み続けています。** 歴史的に、高齢の所有者はダウンサイジングして市場に在庫を供給してきました。しかし現在は、住宅ローンを完済しているか、引っ越すことで失ってしまう低金利の固定金利ローンを抱えているため、多くの人が留まっています。売り手が減るということは、新築とは無関係に、既存住宅の供給がよりひっ迫することを意味します。

segments.src: - **Millennials are in peak buying years, late.** The largest adult generation is now roughly 30 to 45. Recent National Association of Realtors surveys put the median first-time buyer in their late 30s — a large jump from around 30 in the early 1980s. Demand delayed is not demand destroyed, but it changes what people buy and when.
segments.tr: - **ミレニアル世代は、遅れてピークの買い手層に入っています。** 最大の成人世代は現在おおむね30歳から45歳です。全米不動産業者協会（NAR）の最近の調査によると、初めて家を買う人の年齢中央値は30代後半となっており、1980年代初頭の30歳頃から大きく跳ね上がっています。先送りされた需要は消滅したわけではありませんが、人々が何を購入し、いつ購入するかを変えることになります。

segments.src: - **Migration is the local story.** Sun Belt metros keep absorbing domestic movers; high-cost coastal metros keep exporting them. Immigration is a swing variable large enough to move national household formation on its own.
segments.tr: - **移住は地域ごとのストーリーです。** サンベルト（南部・西部）の都市圏は国内からの移住者を吸収し続け、高コストな沿岸都市圏は移住者を排出し続けています。移民は、それ単体で国内の世帯形成を動かすのに十分な規模を持つ変動要因です。

segments.src: - **Two new underwriting variables.** Insurance cost is now a real line item in Florida, Louisiana, and parts of California — enough to change what a buyer can afford at the same price. And office space is in a structural repricing after remote work, with record-high vacancy in some downtowns and a slow trickle of office-to-residential conversions where the floor plates and plumbing allow.
segments.tr: - **2つの新しいアンダーライティング変数。** フロリダ州、ルイジアナ州、およびカリフォルニア州の一部では、保険料が今や現実的な固定費項目となっており、同じ価格であっても買い手が購入できる範囲を変えるほどになっています。また、オフィススペースはリモートワーク以降の構造的な価格再評価の真っ中にあり、一部のダウンタウンでは空室率が過去最高を記録する一方、床スラブや配管が許す場所ではオフィスから住宅へのコンバージョンがゆっくりと進んでいます。

segments.src: Honest framing: nobody forecasts a point.
segments.tr: 率直な見方として、誰も一点の数値を予測することはできません。

segments.src: You forecast *drivers* — interest rates, construction costs, household formation, and policy (zoning reform like Minneapolis ending single-family-only zoning, or the wave of state ADU laws) — and you carry a range.
segments.tr: 予測するのは*ドライバー*（金利、建設コスト、世帯形成、そして政策。例えばミネアポリス市が単一家族専用規制を廃止したような用途地域の改革や、州レベルのADU（離れ）法案の波など）であり、幅を持たせて捉えるのです。

segments.src: ### The whole course, in one pass
segments.tr: ### 全講義の総まとめ

segments.src: 1. **Property is a bundle of rights** — use, exclude, transfer — not just dirt.
segments.tr: 1. **不動産は権利の束**（使用権、排除権、譲渡権）であり、単なる土ではありません。

segments.src: 2. **The market is local, illiquid, and heterogeneous**, so "the housing market" is a convenient fiction.
segments.tr: **市場は地域密着型で、流動性が低く、異質である**ため、「住宅市場」というのは都合の良いフィクションに過ぎません。

segments.src: 3. **Supply is inelastic short-run**; demand shocks hit price before they hit quantity.
segments.tr: 3. **供給は短期的に非弾力的小**であり、需要ショックは数量に影響する前に価格に直撃します。

segments.src: 4. **Value has three lenses**: sales comparison, cost, and income.
segments.tr: 4. **価値には3つの視点があります**：売買事例比較法、原価法、収益還元法。

segments.src: 5. **Highest and best use** — legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, maximally productive.
segments.tr: 5. **最高最善の使用** — 法的に許可され、物理的に可能で、財務的に実現可能で、最大限に生産的な利用。

segments.src: 6. **`NOI = Gross Income − Vacancy − Operating Expenses`** (debt service is *not* an operating expense).
segments.tr: 6. **`NOI = Gross Income − Vacancy − Operating Expenses`**（借入金返済は営業費用*ではありません*）。

segments.src: 7. **`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`** — a price tag on risk and growth, not a return you'll actually receive.
segments.tr: 7. **`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`** — 実際に受け取るリターンではなく、リスクと成長に対する値札です。

segments.src: 8. **Mortgages**: amortization, fixed vs. adjustable, LTV, DTI.
segments.tr: 8. **住宅ローン**：償還、固定か変動か、LTV（借入金対物件価格比率）、DTI（負債対所得比率）。

segments.src: 9. **Leverage** amplifies both directions; it's positive only while returns exceed borrowing cost.
segments.tr: 9. **レバレッジ**は両方向に増幅します。リターンが借入コストを上回る場合にのみプラスとなります。

segments.src: 10. **Cash flow analysis** beats appreciation stories, because appreciation is a guess and cash flow is a schedule.
segments.tr: 10. **キャッシュフロー分析**は値上がり期待のストーリーを凌駕します。値上がりは推測であり、キャッシュフローはスケジュールだからです。

segments.src: 11. **Taxes matter**: depreciation, deductions, 1031 exchanges.
segments.tr: 11. **税金は重要です**：減価償却、控除、1031エクスチェンジ（同種資産交換）。

segments.src: 12. **Land use and zoning** decide what can exist before economics decides what should.
segments.tr: 12. **土地利用と用途地域**は、経済学が「どうあるべきか」を決める前に、「何が存在できるか」を決定します。

segments.src: 13. **Brokerage and agency**: fiduciary duty, disclosure, and how the transaction actually closes.
segments.tr: 13. **仲介と代理**：信認義務、開示、そして取引が実際にどのように完了するか。

segments.src: 14. **Development and property management**: entitlement risk up front, operating discipline forever after.
segments.tr: 14. **開発とプロパティマネジメント**：初期のエントタイトルメント（開発権利取得）リスク、そしてその後の永続的な運営規律。

segments.src: 15. **Cycles**: recovery, expansion, hypersupply, recession — and the lag that makes overbuilding chronic.
segments.tr: 15. **サイクル**：回復、拡張、過剰供給、後退 — そして過剰建設を慢性化させるタイムラグ。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活において

segments.src: Priya and Marcus are shopping in Charlotte, North Carolina, with about $85,000 down.
segments.tr: プリアとマーカスはノースカロライナ州シャーロットで、約85,000ドルの頭金を用意して物件を探しています。

segments.src: They start on a listing app.
segments.tr: 彼らはリスティングアプリから始めます。

segments.src: A three-bedroom in NoDa shows an online estimate of $412,000.
segments.tr: NoDa地区にある3LDKの物件のオンライン査定額は412,000ドルと表示されています。

segments.src: They offer $405,000, get it accepted — and the appraisal comes back at $395,000.
segments.tr: 彼らが405,000ドルでオファーして受理されましたが、鑑定評価（アプライザル）の結果は395,000ドルでした。

segments.src: That $10,000 gap is theirs to cover in cash, because the lender lends against the appraisal, not the algorithm (Lectures 4 and 8).
segments.tr: その10,000ドルのギャップは彼らが現金で埋めなければなりません。なぜなら貸し手はアルゴリズムではなく鑑定評価を基準に融資を行うからです（第4講および第8講）。

segments.src: Proptech got them to the house on a Tuesday night; it didn't get them the value.
segments.tr: プロプテックは火曜日の夜に彼らをその家に導いたものの、価値をもたらしたわけではありません。

segments.src: The seller is 74 and selling because stairs became a problem — he's moving to a single-level place near his daughter.
segments.tr: 売り手は74歳で、階段が問題になったために売却を決意し、娘の近くの平屋に引っ越そうとしています。

segments.src: His neighbors on both sides, same age, aren't moving at all.
segments.tr: 両隣の同じ年齢の隣人たちは、全く引っ越す気配がありません。

segments.src: That's the aging-in-place story in one cul-de-sac, and it's why only nine homes in the neighborhood have traded in three years.
segments.tr: それが1つの袋小路（クルーデサック）における住み続けのストーリーであり、この近隣で過去3年間にわずか9軒しか取引されていない理由がそこにあります。

segments.src: Priya and Marcus had also looked in Tampa, where the sticker prices were lower.
segments.tr: プリアとマーカスはタンパも検討していました。そこでは表示価格がより安価でした。

segments.src: The homeowner's insurance quote — several times what Charlotte runs — erased the difference.
segments.tr: しかし、シャーロットの数倍に達する火災保険の見積もりがその差を相殺してしまいました。

segments.src: Same salary, same rate, different affordability.
segments.tr: 同じ給与、同じ金利であっても、手頃さが異なるのです。

segments.src: That's the new variable, and it doesn't show up in the list price.
segments.tr: それが新しい変数であり、リスティング価格には表示されません。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 3行まとめ

segments.src: - Proptech has crushed information and transaction friction, but valuation risk and illiquidity are unchanged — the Zillow iBuying shutdown is the case study.
segments.tr: - プロプテックは情報と取引の摩擦を粉砕しましたが、評価リスクと流動性の低さは変わっていません。ZillowのiBuying事業閉鎖はその典型的なケーススタディです。

segments.src: - Household formation, not population, drives housing demand; boomers aging in place and millennials buying later are reshaping supply and product type simultaneously.
segments.tr: - 人口ではなく世帯形成が住宅需要を牽引します。住み続けるベビーブーマーと、遅れて購入するミレニアル世代が、供給とプロダクトのタイプを同時に再構築しています。

segments.src: - Forecast drivers and ranges — rates, construction costs, household formation, insurance, and zoning policy — never a single number.
segments.tr: - 予測すべきは単一の数値ではなく、金利、建設コスト、世帯形成、保険、そして用途地域政策といったドライバーとレンジ（幅）です。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ セルフクイズ

segments.src: **Q1.** Which best explains why housing supply responds slowly to a demand shock?
segments.tr: **Q1.** 需要ショックに対して住宅供給がゆっくりとしか反応しない理由を最もよく説明しているものはどれですか？

segments.src: (a) Buyers need time to get pre-approved
segments.tr: (a) 買い手が事前承認を得るのに時間がかかるため

segments.src: (b) Entitlement, financing, and construction take years
segments.tr: (b) 開発権利取得、融資、建設に何年もかかるため

segments.src: (c) Brokers limit how many listings they take
segments.tr: (c) 仲介業者が引き受ける物件数を制限しているため

segments.src: (d) Appraisals are backward-looking
segments.tr: (d) 不動産鑑定は過去を振り返るものであるため

segments.src: **Q2.** (O/X) An online automated valuation model (AVM) estimate is functionally the same as a lender's appraisal.
segments.tr: **Q2.** (O/X) オンラインの自動評価モデル（AVM）の推定値は、貸し手の不動産鑑定（アプライザル）と機能的に同じである。

segments.src: **Q3.** Which most directly drives housing demand?
segments.tr: **Q3.** 住宅需要を最も直接的に牽引するものはどれですか？

segments.src: (a) Total population
segments.tr: (a) 総人口

segments.src: (b) Number of licensed agents
segments.tr: (b) 登録エージェントの数

segments.src: (c) Household formation
segments.tr: (c) 世帯形成

segments.src: (d) The national homeownership rate
segments.tr: (d) 全国の持ち家率

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — (b).** From entitlement to certificate of occupancy is typically two to five years, so short-run supply is close to fixed and demand shocks land on price first (Lecture 3).*
segments.tr: *解答：**Q1 — (b)。** エントタイトルメント（開発権利取得）から検査済証の発行まで通常2〜5年かかるため、短期的な供給はほぼ固定されており、需要ショックはまず価格に打撃を与えます（第3講）。*

segments.src: ***Q2 — X.** An AVM is a statistical estimate from public records and comps; an appraisal is a licensed professional's opinion of value, and the lender sizes the loan off the appraisal.
segments.tr: ***Q2 — X。** AVMは公開記録や類似物件から導き出された統計的推計値であり、鑑定評価はライセンスを持つ専門家による価値の意見であり、貸し手はその鑑定評価をベースに融資額を決定します。

segments.src: The gap between them is paid in cash by the buyer.*
segments.tr: その間のギャップは買い手が現金で支払います.*

segments.src: ***Q3 — (c).** Households, not individuals, occupy units.
segments.tr: ***Q3 — (c)。** 個人ではなく世帯がユニットを占有します。

segments.src: Population can be flat while demand rises if people form smaller, more numerous households — through delayed marriage, divorce, or aging alone.*
segments.tr: 晩婚化、離婚、あるいは単身高齢化などにより人々がより小さく多くの世帯を形成する場合、人口が横ばいであっても需要は増加し得ます.*

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 本日の用語

segments.src: - **Proptech** — technology applied to property information, transactions, and building operations.
segments.tr: - **プロプテック** — 不動産情報、取引、ビル運営に適用されるテクノロジー。

segments.src: - **AVM (Automated Valuation Model)** — a statistical home value estimate built from public records and comparable sales; not an appraisal.
segments.tr: - **AVM（自動評価モデル）** — 公開記録と類似物件の売買データから構築された統計的な住宅価値推計値。鑑定評価（アプライザル）ではありません。

segments.src: - **Household formation** — the rate at which new occupied housing units are created; the truest demand driver in housing.
segments.tr: - **世帯形成** — 新たに占有される住宅ユニットが創出されるペース。住宅における真の需要ドライバー。

segments.src: - **Aging in place** — older owners staying in their homes rather than downsizing, which reduces resale inventory turnover.
segments.tr: - **エイジング・イン・プレイス（住み慣れた地域での高齢化）** — 高齢の所有者がダウンサイジングせず自宅に留まることであり、これにより中古住宅市場の在庫回転率が低下する。

segments.src: - **Adaptive reuse** — converting a building to a new use (most topically, office to residential) when the structure and systems permit it.
segments.tr: - **アダプティブ・リユース（用途変更）** — 構造やシステムが許す場合に、建物を新しい用途（最も時事的な話題としてはオフィスから住宅へ）にコンバージョンすること。

de.title: [Real Estate 101 #15] Das nächste Jahrzehnt entsteht bereits – Proptech, Demografie und der gesamte Kurs in einer Sitzung

segments.src: > Real estate changes slowly, which is exactly why the two slowest forces — technology and demographics — are the ones worth watching. Here's the outlook, plus a one-pass recap of everything from Lecture 1 to now.
segments.tr: > Immobilien verändern sich langsam, was genau der Grund ist, warum die beiden langsamsten Kräfte – Technologie und Demografie – diejenigen sind, die man beobachten sollte. Hier ist der Ausblick sowie eine Zusammenfassung von Vorlesung 1 bis heute in einem Durchgang.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Das heutige Konzept

segments.src: Most forecasts fail because they try to guess next quarter.
segments.tr: Die meisten Prognosen scheitern, weil sie versuchen, das nächste Quartal zu erraten.

segments.src: Real estate barely moves that fast.
segments.tr: So schnell bewegt sich der Immobilienmarkt kaum.

segments.src: A subdivision takes two to four years from raw land to keys; an apartment tower can take five.
segments.tr: Ein Wohngebiet benötigt zwei bis vier Jahre vom unbebauten Grundstück bis zur Schlüsselübergabe; ein Apartmentturm kann fünf brauchen.

segments.src: Zoning changes take longer than that.
segments.tr: Zonierungsänderungen dauern noch länger.

segments.src: So the useful question isn't "where are prices going next month" — it's "which slow forces are already locked in?"
segments.tr: Die nützliche Frage lautet also nicht „Wohin gehen die Preise nächsten Monat?“ – sondern „Welche langsamen Kräfte sind bereits fixiert?“

segments.src: Two are.
segments.tr: Zwei sind es.

segments.src: **Proptech: friction is disappearing, risk isn't.** Technology has arrived in property in three layers.
segments.tr: **Proptech: Reibung verschwindet, Risiko nicht.** Die Technologie ist in drei Ebenen in der Immobilienbranche angekommen.

segments.src: The *information* layer came first — listing portals and automated valuation models turned a business built on private data into one where a buyer can pull comps at midnight.
segments.tr: Die *Informationsschicht* kam zuerst – Listing-Portale und automatisierte Bewertungsmodelle machten aus einem Geschäft, das auf privaten Daten basierte, eines, bei dem ein Käufer um Mitternacht Vergleichswerte abrufen kann.

segments.src: The *transaction* layer came next: digital closings, remote online notarization, title automation, and "iBuyers" that buy your house with an algorithm and a cash offer.
segments.tr: Die *Transaktionsschicht* folgte als Nächstes: digitale Notarabwicklungen, Online-Notarisierung aus der Ferne, Titelautomatisierung und „iBuyers“, die Ihr Haus mit einem Algorithmus und einem Barangebot kaufen.

segments.src: The *operations* layer is the quietest and probably the largest — building management software, smart meters, energy analytics, and leasing platforms that squeeze cost out of the 30 years *after* the sale.
segments.tr: Die *Betriebsschicht* ist die ruhigste und wahrscheinlich größte – Gebäudemanagement-Software, intelligente Zähler, Energieanalytik und Leasing-Plattformen, die Kosten aus den 30 Jahren *nach* dem Verkauf herausquetschen.

segments.src: The instructive part is where proptech has failed.
segments.tr: Der lehrreiche Teil ist der, wo Proptech gescheitert ist.

segments.src: Zillow shut down its home-buying arm in 2021 after heavy losses; a model that estimates value well on average can still be wrong expensively on individual houses.
segments.tr: Zillow hat seinen Immobilienkauf-Arm 2021 nach schweren Verlusten geschlossen; ein Modell, das den Wert im Durchschnitt gut schätzt, kann bei einzelnen Häusern immer noch teuer falsch liegen.

segments.src: Technology compressed information asymmetry and paperwork.
segments.tr: Die Technologie hat Informationsasymmetrien und Papierkram komprimiert.

segments.src: It did not repeal price risk, illiquidity, or the fact that every parcel is unique.
segments.tr: Sie hat weder Preisrisiken, Illiquidität noch die Tatsache aufgehoben, dass jedes Grundstück ein Unikat ist.

segments.src: Expect more of the same: cheaper information, faster transactions, unchanged fundamentals.
segments.tr: Erwarten Sie mehr vom Gleichen: günstigere Informationen, schnellere Transaktionen, unveränderte Fundamentaldaten.

segments.src: **Demographics: households, not people.** Population growth doesn't buy houses — *household formation* does.
segments.tr: **Demografie: Haushalte, nicht Menschen.** Bevölkerungswachstum kauft keine Häuser – *Haushaltsgründung* tut das.

segments.src: Two roommates splitting a one-bedroom are one household; when they split up, they're two, and demand just rose without a single birth.
segments.tr: Zwei Mitbewohner, die sich eine Einzimmerwohnung teilen, sind ein Haushalt; wenn sie sich trennen, sind sie zwei, und die Nachfrage ist ohne eine einzige Geburt gestiegen.

segments.src: That's why the demographic picture matters in specifics:
segments.tr: Deshalb ist das demografische Bild im Detail wichtig:

segments.src: - **Boomers (born 1946–1964, so 62 to 80 today) are aging in place.** Historically, older owners downsized and released inventory. Many now stay — the home is paid off or carries a low fixed-rate mortgage they'd lose by moving. Fewer sellers means tighter resale supply, independent of new construction.
segments.tr: - **Boomer (geboren 1946–1964, heute also 62 bis 80 Jahre alt) altern in ihrer gewohnten Umgebung.** Historisch gesehen verkleinerten sich ältere Eigentümer und gaben Inventar frei. Viele bleiben jetzt – das Haus ist abbezahlt oder hat eine günstige Hypothek mit festem Zinssatz, die sie durch einen Umzug verlieren würden. Weniger Verkäufer bedeuten ein knapperes Wiederverkaufsangebot, unabhängig von Neubauten.

segments.src: - **Millennials are in peak buying years, late.** The largest adult generation is now roughly 30 to 45. Recent National Association of Realtors surveys put the median first-time buyer in their late 30s — a large jump from around 30 in the early 1980s. Demand delayed is not demand destroyed, but it changes what people buy and when.
segments.tr: - **Millennials sind in ihren späten Jahren des Spitzenkaufs.** Die größte Generation von Erwachsenen ist jetzt etwa 30 bis 45 Jahre alt. Jüngste Umfragen der National Association of Realtors beziffern das Medianalter von Erstkäufern auf Ende 30 – ein großer Sprung von etwa 30 in den frühen 1980er Jahren. Verzögerte Nachfrage ist keine zerstörte Nachfrage, aber sie verändert, was die Leute kaufen und wann.

segments.src: - **Migration is the local story.** Sun Belt metros keep absorbing domestic movers; high-cost coastal metros keep exporting them. Immigration is a swing variable large enough to move national household formation on its own.
segments.tr: - **Migration ist die lokale Geschichte.** Die Metropolen im Sun Belt nehmen weiterhin Binnenmigranten auf; kostenintensive Küstenmetropolen exportieren sie weiterhin. Einwanderung ist eine Schaukelvariable, die groß genug ist, um die nationale Haushaltsgründung von alleine zu bewegen.

segments.src: - **Two new underwriting variables.** Insurance cost is now a real line item in Florida, Louisiana, and parts of California — enough to change what a buyer can afford at the same price. And office space is in a structural repricing after remote work, with record-high vacancy in some downtowns and a slow trickle of office-to-residential conversions where the floor plates and plumbing allow.
segments.tr: - **Zwei neue Zeichnungsvariablen.** Die Versicherungskosten sind in Florida, Louisiana und Teilen Kaliforniens mittlerweile ein echter Kostenpunkt – genug, um zu verändern, was sich ein Käufer zum selben Preis leisten kann. Und Büroflächen befinden sich nach der Remote-Arbeit in einer strukturellen Preisanpassung, mit rekordhohen Leerständen in einigen Innenstädten und einem langsamen Strom von Büro-zu-Wohn-Umwandlungen, wo es die Grundrisse und Sanitäranlagen erlauben.

segments.src: Honest framing: nobody forecasts a point.
segments.tr: Ehrlich gesagt: Niemand prognostiziert einen genauen Punkt.

segments.src: You forecast *drivers* — interest rates, construction costs, household formation, and policy (zoning reform like Minneapolis ending single-family-only zoning, or the wave of state ADU laws) — and you carry a range.
segments.tr: Man prognostiziert *Treiber* – Zinssätze, Baukosten, Haushaltsgründung und Politik (Zonierungsreformen wie das Ende der Einfamilienhaus-Zonierung in Minneapolis oder die Welle staatlicher ADU-Gesetze) – und man kalkuliert eine Spanne.

segments.src: ### The whole course, in one pass
segments.tr: ### Der gesamte Kurs in einem Durchgang

segments.src: 1. **Property is a bundle of rights** — use, exclude, transfer — not just dirt.
segments.tr: 1. **Eigentum ist ein Bündel von Rechten** – Nutzung, Ausschluss, Übertragung – nicht nur Dreck.

segments.src: 2. **The market is local, illiquid, and heterogeneous**, so "the housing market" is a convenient fiction.
segments.tr: **Der Markt ist lokal, illiquid und heterogen**, daher ist „der Immobilienmarkt“ eine bequeme Fiktion.

segments.src: 3. **Supply is inelastic short-run**; demand shocks hit price before they hit quantity.
segments.tr: 3. **Das Angebot ist kurzfristig unelastisch**; Nachfrageschocks treffen den Preis, bevor sie die Menge treffen.

segments.src: 4. **Value has three lenses**: sales comparison, cost, and income.
segments.tr: 4. **Der Wert hat drei Linsen**: Vergleichswert, Kosten und Ertrag.

segments.src: 5. **Highest and best use** — legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, maximally productive.
segments.tr: 5. **Höchste und beste Nutzung** – rechtlich zulässig, physisch möglich, finanziell machbar, maximal produktiv.

segments.src: 6. **`NOI = Gross Income − Vacancy − Operating Expenses`** (debt service is *not* an operating expense).
segments.tr: 6. **`NOI = Gross Income − Vacancy − Operating Expenses`** (der Kapitaldienst ist *keine* Betriebsaufwendung).

segments.src: 7. **`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`** — a price tag on risk and growth, not a return you'll actually receive.
segments.tr: 7. **`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`** – ein Preisschild für Risiko und Wachstum, keine Rendite, die Sie tatsächlich erhalten werden.

segments.src: 8. **Mortgages**: amortization, fixed vs. adjustable, LTV, DTI.
segments.tr: 8. **Hypotheken**: Tilgung, fest vs. variabel, Beleihungsauslauf (LTV), Schulden-Einkommens-Verhältnis (DTI).

segments.src: 9. **Leverage** amplifies both directions; it's positive only while returns exceed borrowing cost.
segments.tr: 9. **Leverage** verstärkt beide Richtungen; er ist nur positiv, solange die Rendite die Kreditkosten übersteigt.

segments.src: 10. **Cash flow analysis** beats appreciation stories, because appreciation is a guess and cash flow is a schedule.
segments.tr: 10. **Cashflow-Analyse** schlägt Wertsteigerungsgeschichten, denn Wertsteigerung ist eine Vermutung und Cashflow ein Plan.

segments.src: 11. **Taxes matter**: depreciation, deductions, 1031 exchanges.
segments.tr: 11. **Steuern sind wichtig**: Abschreibung, Abzüge, 1031-Tausch.

segments.src: 12. **Land use and zoning** decide what can exist before economics decides what should.
segments.tr: 12. **Landnutzung und Zonierung** entscheiden, was existieren kann, bevor die Wirtschaft entscheidet, was sollte.

segments.src: 13. **Brokerage and agency**: fiduciary duty, disclosure, and how the transaction actually closes.
segments.tr: 13. **Maklerwesen und Vertretung**: Treuepflicht, Offenlegung und wie die Transaktion tatsächlich abgeschlossen wird.

segments.src: 14. **Development and property management**: entitlement risk up front, operating discipline forever after.
segments.tr: 14. **Entwicklung und Immobilienverwaltung**: Genehmigungsrisiko im Voraus, Betriebsdisziplin für immer danach.

segments.src: 15. **Cycles**: recovery, expansion, hypersupply, recession — and the lag that makes overbuilding chronic.
segments.tr: 15. **Zyklen**: Erholung, Expansion, Überangebot, Rezession – und die Verzögerung, die Überbauung chronisch macht.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.src: Priya and Marcus are shopping in Charlotte, North Carolina, with about $85,000 down.
segments.tr: Priya und Marcus suchen in Charlotte, North Carolina, mit etwa 85.000 US-Dollar Eigenkapital.

segments.src: They start on a listing app.
segments.tr: Sie beginnen auf einer Listing-App.

segments.src: A three-bedroom in NoDa shows an online estimate of $412,000.
segments.tr: Ein Haus mit drei Schlafzimmern in NoDa zeigt eine Online-Schätzung von 412.000 US-Dollar.

segments.src: They offer $405,000, get it accepted — and the appraisal comes back at $395,000.
segments.tr: Sie bieten 405.000 US-Dollar, bekommen den Zuschlag – und die Schätzung (Appraisal) beläuft sich auf 395.000 US-Dollar.

segments.src: That $10,000 gap is theirs to cover in cash, because the lender lends against the appraisal, not the algorithm (Lectures 4 and 8).
segments.tr: Diese Lücke von 10.000 US-Dollar müssen sie in bar ausgleichen, da der Kreditgeber auf Basis der Schätzung und nicht des Algorithmus leiht (Vorlesungen 4 und 8).

segments.src: Proptech got them to the house on a Tuesday night; it didn't get them the value.
segments.tr: Proptech hat sie an einem Dienstagabend zum Haus gebracht; es hat ihnen nicht den Wert verschafft.

segments.src: The seller is 74 and selling because stairs became a problem — he's moving to a single-level place near his daughter.
segments.tr: Der Verkäufer ist 74 Jahre alt und verkauft, weil Treppen zum Problem wurden – er zieht in eine ebenerdige Unterkunft in der Nähe seiner Tochter.

segments.src: His neighbors on both sides, same age, aren't moving at all.
segments.tr: Seine Nachbarn auf beiden Seiten, gleichen Alters, ziehen überhaupt nicht um.

segments.src: That's the aging-in-place story in one cul-de-sac, and it's why only nine homes in the neighborhood have traded in three years.
segments.tr: Das ist die Geschichte des Alterns in vertrauter Umgebung in einer Sackgasse, und das ist der Grund, warum in den letzten drei Jahren nur neun Häuser in der Nachbarschaft gehandelt wurden.

segments.src: Priya and Marcus had also looked in Tampa, where the sticker prices were lower.
segments.tr: Priya und Marcus hatten auch in Tampa gesucht, wo die Listenpreise niedriger waren.

segments.src: The homeowner's insurance quote — several times what Charlotte runs — erased the difference.
segments.tr: Das Angebot für die Hausrat- bzw. Gebäudeversicherung – ein Vielfaches dessen, was Charlotte kostet – löschte den Unterschied aus.

segments.src: Same salary, same rate, different affordability.
segments.tr: Gleiches Gehalt, gleicher Zinssatz, unterschiedliche Erschwinglichkeit.

segments.src: That's the new variable, and it doesn't show up in the list price.
segments.tr: Das ist die neue Variable, und sie taucht im Listenpreis nicht auf.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Zusammenfassung in drei Zeilen

segments.src: - Proptech has crushed information and transaction friction, but valuation risk and illiquidity are unchanged — the Zillow iBuying shutdown is the case study.
segments.tr: - Proptech hat Informations- und Transaktionsreibungen zerkleinert, aber das Bewertungsrisiko und die Illiquidität sind unverändert – die Abschaltung des iBuying von Zillow ist die Fallstudie.

segments.src: - Household formation, not population, drives housing demand; boomers aging in place and millennials buying later are reshaping supply and product type simultaneously.
segments.tr: - Haushaltsgründung, nicht Bevölkerung, treibt die Wohnungsnachfrage an; Boomer, die in ihren Häusern altern, und Millennials, die später kaufen, formen Angebot und Produkttyp gleichzeitig um.

segments.src: - Forecast drivers and ranges — rates, construction costs, household formation, insurance, and zoning policy — never a single number.
segments.tr: - Prognostizieren Sie Treiber und Spannen – Zinssätze, Baukosten, Haushaltsgründung, Versicherungen und Zonierungspolitik –, niemals eine einzelne Zahl.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Selbsttest

segments.src: **Q1.** Which best explains why housing supply responds slowly to a demand shock?
segments.tr: **F1.** Was erklärt am besten, warum das Wohnungsangebot langsam auf einen Nachfrageschocks reagiert?

segments.src: (a) Buyers need time to get pre-approved
segments.tr: (a) Käufer brauchen Zeit, um eine Vorabgenehmigung zu erhalten

segments.src: (b) Entitlement, financing, and construction take years
segments.tr: (b) Genehmigung, Finanzierung und Bau dauern Jahre

segments.src: (c) Brokers limit how many listings they take
segments.tr: (c) Makler begrenzen, wie viele Angebote sie annehmen

segments.src: (d) Appraisals are backward-looking
segments.tr: (d) Bewertungen blicken in die Vergangenheit

segments.src: **Q2.** (O/X) An online automated valuation model (AVM) estimate is functionally the same as a lender's appraisal.
segments.tr: **F2.** (R/F) Die Schätzung eines automatisierten Online-Bewertungsmodells (AVM) ist funktional dasselbe wie die Schätzung eines Kreditgebers.

segments.src: **Q3.** Which most directly drives housing demand?
segments.tr: **F3.** Was treibt die Wohnungsnachfrage am direktesten an?

segments.src: (a) Total population
segments.tr: (a) Gesamtbevölkerung

segments.src: (b) Number of licensed agents
segments.tr: (b) Anzahl der lizenzierten Makler

segments.src: (c) Household formation
segments.tr: (c) Haushaltsgründung

segments.src: (d) The national homeownership rate
segments.tr: (d) Die nationale Wohneigentumsquote

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — (b).** From entitlement to certificate of occupancy is typically two to five years, so short-run supply is close to fixed and demand shocks land on price first (Lecture 3).*
segments.tr: *Antworten: **Q1 — (b).** Von der Genehmigung bis zur Bezugsgenehmigung sind es typischerweise zwei bis fünf Jahre, sodass das kurzfristige Angebot nahe an fix ist und Nachfrageschocks zuerst auf den Preis treffen (Vorlesung 3).*

segments.src: ***Q2 — X.** An AVM is a statistical estimate from public records and comps; an appraisal is a licensed professional's opinion of value, and the lender sizes the loan off the appraisal.
segments.tr: ***Q2 — F.** Ein AVM ist eine statistische Schätzung aus öffentlichen Aufzeichnungen und Vergleichswerten; eine Schätzung ist die Meinung eines lizenzierten Experten zum Wert, und der Kreditgeber bemisst den Kredit anhand dieser Schätzung.

segments.src: The gap between them is paid in cash by the buyer.*
segments.tr: Die Lücke dazwischen wird vom Käufer in bar bezahlt.*

segments.src: ***Q3 — (c).** Households, not individuals, occupy units.
segments.tr: ***Q3 — (c).** Haushalte, nicht Einzelpersonen, bewohnen Einheiten.

segments.src: Population can be flat while demand rises if people form smaller, more numerous households — through delayed marriage, divorce, or aging alone.*
segments.tr: Die Bevölkerung kann stagnieren, während die Nachfrage steigt, wenn Menschen kleinere, zahlreichere Haushalte bilden – durch spätere Heirat, Scheidung oder alleiniges Altern.*

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Heutige Begriffe

segments.src: - **Proptech** — technology applied to property information, transactions, and building operations.
segments.tr: - **Proptech** – Technologie angewandt auf Immobilieninformationen, Transaktionen und Gebäudeoperationen.

segments.src: - **AVM (Automated Valuation Model)** — a statistical home value estimate built from public records and comparable sales; not an appraisal.
segments.tr: - **AVM (Automated Valuation Model)** – eine statistische Schätzung des Hauswerts aus öffentlichen Aufzeichnungen und vergleichbaren Verkäufen; keine Bewertung durch einen Sachverständigen.

segments.src: - **Household formation** — the rate at which new occupied housing units are created; the truest demand driver in housing.
segments.tr: - **Haushaltsgründung** – die Rate, mit der neue bewohnte Wohneinheiten geschaffen werden; der wahrhaftigste Nachfragetreiber im Wohnungsbau.

segments.src: - **Aging in place** — older owners staying in their homes rather than downsizing, which reduces resale inventory turnover.
segments.tr: - **Aging in place** – ältere Eigentümer, die in ihren Häusern bleiben, anstatt sich zu verkleinern, was den Umsatz des Wiederverkaufsbestands verringert.

segments.src: - **Adaptive reuse** — converting a building to a new use (most topically, office to residential) when the structure and systems permit it.
segments.tr: - **Adaptive Reuse** – die Umwidmung eines Gebäudes für eine neue Nutzung (am aktuellsten: Büro zu Wohnen), wenn es die Struktur und die Systeme erlauben.

vi.title: [Bất động sản căn bản #15] Thập kỷ tiếp theo đã và đang được xây dựng — Proptech, nhân khẩu học và toàn bộ khóa học trong một lần

segments.src: > Real estate changes slowly, which is exactly why the two slowest forces — technology and demographics — are the ones worth watching. Here's the outlook, plus a one-pass recap of everything from Lecture 1 to now.
segments.tr: > Bất động sản thay đổi chậm, đó chính là lý do tại sao hai lực lượng chậm nhất — công nghệ và nhân khẩu học — lại là những yếu tố đáng chú ý nhất. Dưới đây là triển vọng, cùng với bản tóm tắt một lượt từ Bài giảng 1 cho đến nay.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Khái niệm hôm nay

segments.src: Most forecasts fail because they try to guess next quarter.
segments.tr: Hầu hết các dự báo đều thất bại vì họ cố gắng đoán quý tới.

segments.src: Real estate barely moves that fast.
segments.tr: Bất động sản hầu như không di chuyển nhanh như vậy.

segments.src: A subdivision takes two to four years from raw land to keys; an apartment tower can take five.
segments.tr: Một khu phân lô mất từ hai đến bốn năm từ đất thô đến khi nhận chìa khóa; một tòa nhà chung cư có thể mất năm năm.

segments.src: Zoning changes take longer than that.
segments.tr: Thay đổi quy hoạch mất nhiều thời gian hơn thế.

segments.src: So the useful question isn't "where are prices going next month" — it's "which slow forces are already locked in?"
segments.tr: Vì vậy, câu hỏi hữu ích không phải là "giá sẽ đi về đâu vào tháng tới" — mà là "những lực lượng chậm nào đã được ấn định?"

segments.src: Two are.
segments.tr: Có hai lực lượng.

segments.src: **Proptech: friction is disappearing, risk isn't.** Technology has arrived in property in three layers.
segments.tr: **Proptech: ma sát đang biến mất, rủi ro thì không.** Công nghệ đã đến với bất động sản qua ba tầng.

segments.src: The *information* layer came first — listing portals and automated valuation models turned a business built on private data into one where a buyer can pull comps at midnight.
segments.tr: Tầng *thông tin* xuất hiện đầu tiên — các cổng thông tin niêm yết và mô hình định giá tự động đã biến một doanh nghiệp được xây dựng trên dữ liệu riêng tư thành nơi người mua có thể tra cứu giá so sánh vào nửa đêm.

segments.src: The *transaction* layer came next: digital closings, remote online notarization, title automation, and "iBuyers" that buy your house with an algorithm and a cash offer.
segments.tr: Tầng *giao dịch* xuất hiện tiếp theo: ký kết kỹ thuật số, công chứng trực tuyến từ xa, tự động hóa quyền sở hữu và "iBuyers" mua nhà của bạn bằng thuật toán và đề nghị tiền mặt.

segments.src: The *operations* layer is the quietest and probably the largest — building management software, smart meters, energy analytics, and leasing platforms that squeeze cost out of the 30 years *after* the sale.
segments.tr: Tầng *vận hành* là tầng lặng lẽ nhất và có lẽ là lớn nhất — phần mềm quản lý tòa nhà, đồng hồ thông minh, phân tích năng lượng và nền tảng cho thuê giúp tiết kiệm chi phí trong suốt 30 năm *sau* khi bán.

segments.src: The instructive part is where proptech has failed.
segments.tr: Phần mang tính hướng dẫn là nơi proptech đã thất bại.

segments.src: Zillow shut down its home-buying arm in 2021 after heavy losses; a model that estimates value well on average can still be wrong expensively on individual houses.
segments.tr: Zillow đã đóng cửa bộ phận mua nhà của mình vào năm 2021 sau những tổn thất nặng nề; một mô hình ước tính giá trị tốt trung bình vẫn có thể sai lầm đắt giá đối với từng ngôi nhà cụ thể.

segments.src: Technology compressed information asymmetry and paperwork.
segments.tr: Công nghệ đã nén sự bất đối xứng thông tin và thủ tục giấy tờ.

segments.src: It did not repeal price risk, illiquidity, or the fact that every parcel is unique.
segments.tr: Nó không xóa bỏ rủi ro giá cả, tính kém thanh khoản, hoặc thực tế là mỗi thửa đất đều là duy nhất.

segments.src: Expect more of the same: cheaper information, faster transactions, unchanged fundamentals.
segments.tr: Hãy mong đợi nhiều hơn thế: thông tin rẻ hơn, giao dịch nhanh hơn, các nguyên tắc cơ bản không đổi.

segments.src: **Demographics: households, not people.** Population growth doesn't buy houses — *household formation* does.
segments.tr: **Nhân khẩu học: hộ gia đình, chứ không phải con người.** Tăng trưởng dân số không mua nhà — sự *hình thành hộ gia đình* mới mua.

segments.src: Two roommates splitting a one-bedroom are one household; when they split up, they're two, and demand just rose without a single birth.
segments.tr: Hai bạn cùng phòng chia đôi căn hộ một phòng ngủ là một hộ gia đình; khi họ tách ra, họ thành hai, và nhu cầu vừa tăng lên mà không cần một ca sinh nào.

segments.src: That's why the demographic picture matters in specifics:
segments.tr: Đó là lý do tại sao bức tranh nhân khẩu học quan trọng ở các chi tiết cụ thể:

segments.src: - **Boomers (born 1946–1964, so 62 to 80 today) are aging in place.** Historically, older owners downsized and released inventory. Many now stay — the home is paid off or carries a low fixed-rate mortgage they'd lose by moving. Fewer sellers means tighter resale supply, independent of new construction.
segments.tr: - **Thế hệ Baby Boomers (sinh năm 1946–1964, tức là 62 đến 80 tuổi ngày nay) đang già đi tại chỗ.** Về mặt lịch sử, các chủ sở hữu lớn tuổi thường thu nhỏ nhà ở và giải phóng hàng tồn kho. Nhiều người hiện nay vẫn ở lại — ngôi nhà đã được trả hết hoặc có khoản thế chấp lãi suất cố định thấp mà họ sẽ mất nếu chuyển đi. Ít người bán hơn đồng nghĩa với nguồn cung bán lại thắt chặt hơn, độc lập với việc xây dựng mới.

segments.src: - **Millennials are in peak buying years, late.** The largest adult generation is now roughly 30 to 45. Recent National Association of Realtors surveys put the median first-time buyer in their late 30s — a large jump from around 30 in the early 1980s. Demand delayed is not demand destroyed, but it changes what people buy and when.
segments.tr: - **Thế hệ Millennials đang trong những năm mua nhà cao điểm, nhưng muộn hơn.** Thế hệ trưởng thành lớn nhất hiện nay khoảng từ 30 đến 45 tuổi. Các khảo sát gần đây của Hiệp hội Môi giới Bất động sản Quốc gia cho thấy độ tuổi trung bình của người mua lần đầu ở cuối độ tuổi 30 — một bước nhảy vọt lớn so với khoảng 30 vào đầu những năm 1980. Nhu cầu bị trì hoãn không phải là nhu cầu bị phá hủy, nhưng nó thay đổi những gì mọi người mua và khi nào.

segments.src: - **Migration is the local story.** Sun Belt metros keep absorbing domestic movers; high-cost coastal metros keep exporting them. Immigration is a swing variable large enough to move national household formation on its own.
segments.tr: - **Di cư là câu chuyện địa phương.** Các đô thị Vành đai Mặt trời tiếp tục thu hút những người di chuyển trong nước; các đô thị ven biển chi phí cao tiếp tục đẩy họ đi. Nhập cư là một biến số đủ lớn để tự dịch chuyển sự hình thành hộ gia đình quốc gia.

segments.src: - **Two new underwriting variables.** Insurance cost is now a real line item in Florida, Louisiana, and parts of California — enough to change what a buyer can afford at the same price. And office space is in a structural repricing after remote work, with record-high vacancy in some downtowns and a slow trickle of office-to-residential conversions where the floor plates and plumbing allow.
segments.tr: - **Hai biến số bảo lãnh phát hành mới.** Chi phí bảo hiểm hiện là một khoản mục thực tế ở Florida, Louisiana và một phần California — đủ để thay đổi những gì người mua có thể chi trả ở cùng một mức giá. Và không gian văn phòng đang được định giá lại về mặt cấu trúc sau khi làm việc từ xa, với tỷ lệ trống cao kỷ lục ở một số trung tâm thành phố và một dòng nhỏ các chuyển đổi văn phòng thành nhà ở nơi các mặt sàn và hệ thống ống nước cho phép.

segments.src: Honest framing: nobody forecasts a point.
segments.tr: Khung nhìn trung thực: không ai dự báo một điểm số chính xác.

segments.src: You forecast *drivers* — interest rates, construction costs, household formation, and policy (zoning reform like Minneapolis ending single-family-only zoning, or the wave of state ADU laws) — and you carry a range.
segments.tr: Bạn dự báo các *yếu tố thúc đẩy* — lãi suất, chi phí xây dựng, sự hình thành hộ gia đình và chính sách (cải cách quy hoạch như Minneapolis chấm dứt quy hoạch chỉ dành cho đơn gia cư, hoặc làn sóng luật ADU của tiểu bang) — và bạn duy trì một biên độ.

segments.src: ### The whole course, in one pass
segments.tr: ### Toàn bộ khóa học, trong một lần

segments.src: 1. **Property is a bundle of rights** — use, exclude, transfer — not just dirt.
segments.tr: 1. **Bất động sản là một tập hợp các quyền** — sử dụng, loại trừ, chuyển nhượng — chứ không chỉ là đất đai.

segments.src: 2. **The market is local, illiquid, and heterogeneous**, so "the housing market" is a convenient fiction.
segments.tr: 2. **Thị trường mang tính địa phương, kém thanh khoản và không đồng nhất**, vì vậy "thị trường nhà ở" là một hư cấu thuận tiện.

segments.src: 3. **Supply is inelastic short-run**; demand shocks hit price before they hit quantity.
segments.tr: 3. **Cung không co giãn trong ngắn hạn**; các cú sốc cầu tác động đến giá trước khi tác động đến số lượng.

segments.src: 4. **Value has three lenses**: sales comparison, cost, and income.
segments.tr: 4. **Giá trị có ba lăng kính**: so sánh bán hàng, chi phí và thu nhập.

segments.src: 5. **Highest and best use** — legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, maximally productive.
segments.tr: 5. **Sử dụng cao nhất và tốt nhất** — được pháp luật cho phép, có thể về mặt vật lý, khả thi về mặt tài chính, tối đa hóa năng suất.

segments.src: 6. **`NOI = Gross Income − Vacancy − Operating Expenses`** (debt service is *not* an operating expense).
segments.tr: 6. **`NOI = Gross Income − Vacancy − Operating Expenses`** (dịch vụ nợ *không phải* là chi phí vận hành).

segments.src: 7. **`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`** — a price tag on risk and growth, not a return you'll actually receive.
segments.tr: 7. **`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`** — nhãn giá cho rủi ro và tăng trưởng, không phải là lợi nhuận bạn thực sự nhận được.

segments.src: 8. **Mortgages**: amortization, fixed vs. adjustable, LTV, DTI.
segments.tr: 8. **Khoản thế chấp**: khấu hao, cố định so với điều chỉnh, LTV, DTI.

segments.src: 9. **Leverage** amplifies both directions; it's positive only while returns exceed borrowing cost.
segments.tr: 9. **Đòn bẩy** khuếch đại cả hai chiều; nó chỉ tích cực khi lợi nhuận vượt quá chi phí đi vay.

segments.src: 10. **Cash flow analysis** beats appreciation stories, because appreciation is a guess and cash flow is a schedule.
segments.tr: 10. **Phân tích dòng tiền** đánh bại các câu chuyện tăng giá, bởi vì tăng giá là phỏng đoán còn dòng tiền là lịch trình.

segments.src: 11. **Taxes matter**: depreciation, deductions, 1031 exchanges.
segments.tr: 11. **Thuế rất quan trọng**: khấu hao, các khoản khấu trừ, giao dịch 1031.

segments.src: 12. **Land use and zoning** decide what can exist before economics decides what should.
segments.tr: 12. **Sử dụng đất và quy hoạch** quyết định những gì có thể tồn tại trước khi kinh tế học quyết định những gì nên tồn tại.

segments.src: 13. **Brokerage and agency**: fiduciary duty, disclosure, and how the transaction actually closes.
segments.tr: 13. **Môi giới và đại lý**: nghĩa vụ ủy thác, công bố thông tin và cách giao dịch thực sự chốt.

segments.src: 14. **Development and property management**: entitlement risk up front, operating discipline forever after.
segments.tr: 14. **Phát triển và quản lý bất động sản**: rủi ro quyền lợi phía trước, kỷ luật vận hành mãi mãi về sau.

segments.src: 15. **Cycles**: recovery, expansion, hypersupply, recession — and the lag that makes overbuilding chronic.
segments.tr: 15. **Chu kỳ**: phục hồi, mở rộng, cung vượt cầu, suy thoái — và độ trễ khiến việc xây dựng quá mức trở thành mãn tính.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Trong cuộc sống hàng ngày

segments.src: Priya and Marcus are shopping in Charlotte, North Carolina, with about $85,000 down.
segments.tr: Priya và Marcus đang mua sắm ở Charlotte, Bắc Carolina, với khoảng 85.000 USD tiền trả trước.

segments.src: They start on a listing app.
segments.tr: Họ bắt đầu trên một ứng dụng niêm yết.

segments.src: A three-bedroom in NoDa shows an online estimate of $412,000.
segments.tr: Căn hộ ba phòng ngủ ở NoDa hiển thị ước tính trực tuyến là 412.000 USD.

segments.src: They offer $405,000, get it accepted — and the appraisal comes back at $395,000.
segments.tr: Họ trả giá 405.000 USD, được chấp nhận — và kết quả thẩm định trả về là 395.000 USD.

segments.src: That $10,000 gap is theirs to cover in cash, because the lender lends against the appraisal, not the algorithm (Lectures 4 and 8).
segments.tr: Khoản chênh lệch 10.000 USD đó là do họ phải chi trả bằng tiền mặt, bởi vì bên cho vay cho vay dựa trên thẩm định, chứ không phải thuật toán (Bài giảng 4 và 8).

segments.src: Proptech got them to the house on a Tuesday night; it didn't get them the value.
segments.tr: Proptech đã đưa họ đến ngôi nhà vào tối thứ Ba; nó không mang lại giá trị cho họ.

segments.src: The seller is 74 and selling because stairs became a problem — he's moving to a single-level place near his daughter.
segments.tr: Người bán năm nay 74 tuổi và đang bán vì cầu thang đã trở thành vấn đề — ông ấy đang chuyển đến một nơi một tầng gần con gái mình.

segments.src: His neighbors on both sides, same age, aren't moving at all.
segments.tr: Những người hàng xóm ở cả hai bên của ông, cùng độ tuổi, hoàn toàn không chuyển đi.

segments.src: That's the aging-in-place story in one cul-de-sac, and it's why only nine homes in the neighborhood have traded in three years.
segments.tr: Đó là câu chuyện già đi tại chỗ trong một con hẻm cụt, và đó là lý do tại sao chỉ có chín ngôi nhà trong khuNeighborhood giao dịch trong ba năm.

segments.src: Priya and Marcus had also looked in Tampa, where the sticker prices were lower.
segments.tr: Priya và Marcus cũng đã xem xét ở Tampa, nơi giá niêm yết thấp hơn.

segments.src: The homeowner's insurance quote — several times what Charlotte runs — erased the difference.
segments.tr: Báo giá bảo hiểm chủ nhà — gấp nhiều lần so với Charlotte — đã xóa sạch sự khác biệt.

segments.src: Same salary, same rate, different affordability.
segments.tr: Cùng mức lương, cùng mức lãi suất, khả năng chi trả khác nhau.

segments.src: That's the new variable, and it doesn't show up in the list price.
segments.tr: Đó là biến số mới, và nó không xuất hiện trong giá niêm yết.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Tóm tắt ba dòng

segments.src: - Proptech has crushed information and transaction friction, but valuation risk and illiquidity are unchanged — the Zillow iBuying shutdown is the case study.
segments.tr: - Proptech đã đè bẹp thông tin và ma sát giao dịch, nhưng rủi ro định giá và tính kém thanh khoản vẫn không đổi — việc đóng cửa iBuying của Zillow là nghiên cứu điển hình.

segments.src: - Household formation, not population, drives housing demand; boomers aging in place and millennials buying later are reshaping supply and product type simultaneously.
segments.tr: - Sự hình thành hộ gia đình, chứ không phải dân số, thúc đẩy nhu cầu nhà ở; thế hệ boomers già đi tại chỗ và thế hệ millennials mua nhà muộn hơn đang định hình lại nguồn cung và loại sản phẩm cùng một lúc.

segments.src: - Forecast drivers and ranges — rates, construction costs, household formation, insurance, and zoning policy — never a single number.
segments.tr: - Các yếu tố thúc đẩy và khoảng dự báo — lãi suất, chi phí xây dựng, sự hình thành hộ gia đình, bảo hiểm và chính sách quy hoạch — không bao giờ là một con số duy nhất.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Trắc nghiệm tự kiểm tra

segments.src: **Q1.** Which best explains why housing supply responds slowly to a demand shock?
segments.tr: **Q1.** Điều nào giải thích rõ nhất tại sao nguồn cung nhà ở phản ứng chậm chạp trước một cú sốc cầu?

segments.src: (a) Buyers need time to get pre-approved
segments.tr: (a) Người mua cần thời gian để được duyệt trước

segments.src: (b) Entitlement, financing, and construction take years
segments.tr: (b) Quyền lợi, tài chính và xây dựng mất nhiều năm

segments.src: (c) Brokers limit how many listings they take
segments.tr: (c) Các môi giới giới hạn số lượng niêm yết mà họ nhận

segments.src: (d) Appraisals are backward-looking
segments.tr: (d) Các thẩm định nhìn về quá khứ

segments.src: **Q2.** (O/X) An online automated valuation model (AVM) estimate is functionally the same as a lender's appraisal.
segments.tr: **Q2.** (O/X) Ước tính mô hình định giá tự động trực tuyến (AVM) có chức năng tương tự như việc thẩm định của người cho vay.

segments.src: **Q3.** Which most directly drives housing demand?
segments.tr: **Q3.** Yếu tố nào thúc đẩy trực tiếp nhất nhu cầu nhà ở?

segments.src: (a) Total population
segments.tr: (a) Tổng dân số

segments.src: (b) Number of licensed agents
segments.tr: (b) Số lượng đại lý được cấp phép

segments.src: (c) Household formation
segments.tr: (c) Sự hình thành hộ gia đình

segments.src: (d) The national homeownership rate
segments.tr: (d) Tỷ lệ sở hữu nhà quốc gia

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — (b).** From entitlement to certificate of occupancy is typically two to five years, so short-run supply is close to fixed and demand shocks land on price first (Lecture 3).*
segments.tr: *Đáp án: **Q1 — (b).** Từ quyền lợi đến giấy chứng nhận quyền sử dụng thường mất từ hai đến năm năm, vì vậy nguồn cung ngắn hạn gần như cố định và các cú sốc cầu tác động vào giá trước (Bài giảng 3).*

segments.src: ***Q2 — X.** An AVM is a statistical estimate from public records and comps; an appraisal is a licensed professional's opinion of value, and the lender sizes the loan off the appraisal.
segments.tr: ***Q2 — X.** AVM là ước tính thống kê từ hồ sơ công khai và các giá so sánh; thẩm định là ý kiến về giá trị của chuyên gia được cấp phép, và người cho vay định kích thước khoản vay dựa trên thẩm định.

segments.src: The gap between them is paid in cash by the buyer.*
segments.tr: Khoản chênh lệch giữa chúng được người mua trả bằng tiền mặt.*

segments.src: ***Q3 — (c).** Households, not individuals, occupy units.
segments.tr: ***Q3 — (c).** Các hộ gia đình, chứ không phải cá nhân, chiếm giữ các đơn vị.

segments.src: Population can be flat while demand rises if people form smaller, more numerous households — through delayed marriage, divorce, or aging alone.*
segments.tr: Dân số có thể không đổi trong khi nhu cầu tăng nếu mọi người hình thành các hộ gia đình nhỏ hơn, đông hơn — thông qua việc kết hôn muộn, ly hôn hoặc sống một mình.*

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Thuật ngữ hôm nay

segments.src: - **Proptech** — technology applied to property information, transactions, and building operations.
segments.tr: - **Proptech** — công nghệ áp dụng cho thông tin bất động sản, giao dịch và vận hành tòa nhà.

segments.src: - **AVM (Automated Valuation Model)** — a statistical home value estimate built from public records and comparable sales; not an appraisal.
segments.tr: - **AVM (Mô hình định giá tự động)** — ước tính giá trị nhà thống kê được xây dựng từ hồ sơ công khai và các giao dịch bán có thể so sánh; không phải là thẩm định.

segments.src: - **Household formation** — the rate at which new occupied housing units are created; the truest demand driver in housing.
segments.tr: - **Sự hình thành hộ gia đình** — tốc độ tạo ra các đơn vị nhà ở có người ở mới; động lực nhu cầu thực tế nhất trong nhà ở.

segments.src: - **Aging in place** — older owners staying in their homes rather than downsizing, which reduces resale inventory turnover.
segments.tr: - **Già đi tại chỗ** — các chủ sở hữu lớn tuổi ở lại nhà của họ thay vì thu nhỏ, điều này làm giảm doanh thu hàng tồn kho bán lại.

segments.src: - **Adaptive reuse** — converting a building to a new use (most topically, office to residential) when the structure and systems permit it.
segments.tr: - **Tái sử dụng thích ứng** — chuyển đổi một tòa nhà sang mục đích sử dụng mới (mang tính thời sự nhất là văn phòng thành nhà ở) khi cấu trúc và hệ thống cho phép.
